question: Does Wren's Run Packmaster give deathtouch only to the Wolf tokens it creates?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it gives deathtouch to all Wolf permanents you control, not just the tokens it creates.
expected.answer: Wren's Run Packmaster gives deathtouch to all Wolf permanents you control, not just the tokens it creates.
